intro: Our Kreative mattress brings you everyday comfort. With breathable design, durable support, and lightweight ease, it is perfect for your modern, flexible living.

features.title: Lightweight and easy to move
features.text: Easy to shift, lift, and reposition—Kreative is light on weight but big on comfort, making everyday living simpler.

features.title: Breathable and moisture-resistant fabric
features.text: The fabric lets air flow freely while keeping moisture out, so you stay cool, dry, and comfortable through every season.

features.title: Lasts with you
features.text: Built to last, its firm yet comfortable design holds shape and support, night after night, year after year.

features.title: High GSM premium fabric
features.text: Wrapped in a soft, high GSM cover that’s both elegant and tough—giving your mattress a plush feel and polished look.

features.title: Tailored sizing for all bed frames
features.text: Fits all standard bed frames with ease—offering you a snug and seamless sleep surface that feels just right.

name: Kreative Single Bed Foam Mattress 78 X 36 X 4 Inches
